defects.description: The signature is verified over JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(rawBody)) instead of the raw bytes the sender signed, so any correctly signed delivery whose body is not byte-identical to compact re-serialization is rejected.
defects.why_missed: The suite builds every body with JSON.stringify and signs that same string, so re-serialization is the identity; no test signs a body with whitespace, reordered keys or escapes as a real sender would.
defects.severity_rationale: A correctly signed payment event can be lost when noncanonical whitespace triggers rejection, limited to that payload form.

detection_criteria.mechanism: The signature is verified over JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(rawBody)) instead of the raw bytes the sender signed, so any correctly signed delivery whose body is not byte-identical to compact re-serialization is rejected.
detection_criteria.proof: Show an exploitable condition, or a concrete violation of a named security property (the input and the boundary it crosses).

defects.description: decodeOrder reads only the v2 field totalCents, so a queued message from the previous release (total in currency units, no v field) decodes with totalCents undefined.
defects.why_missed: The suite only decodes what encodeOrder just produced, so the old writer's format never reaches the reader.
defects.severity_rationale: A consumer using the previous payload shape receives an incomplete order after the producer changes versions.

detection_criteria.mechanism: decodeOrder reads only the v2 field totalCents, so a queued message from the previous release (total in currency units, no v field) decodes with totalCents undefined.
detection_criteria.proof: Show the consumer payload or call that the producer change breaks.
